help.mode_usage:
**Mode & Usage**
- **`/poll mode [mode]`**: Change mode (manual, alwaysfree, pro).
- **`/poll usage [full]`**: Display dashboard (full = details).
- **`/poll fallback <main> [agent]`**: Configure Safety Net.
help.configuration:
**Configuration**
- **`/poll config [key] [value]`**:
   - `lang`: en, fr, etc.
   - `status_gui`: none, alert, all
   - `logs_gui`: none, error, verbose
   - `threshold_tier` / `threshold_wallet`: 0-100
   - `status_bar`: true/false
   - `cost_estimator`: true/false (show cost in outputs)
   - `enablePaidTools`: true/false (wallet protection)
   - `costThreshold`: limit in pollen (default: 0.15)
   - `costConfirmationRequired`: true/false (spend confirmation)
help.models_pricing:
**Models & Pricing**
- **`/poll models [type]`**: List models (type: image, video, audio, text)
- **`/poll pricing`**: Detailed pricing table
- **`/poll infos`**: Explanations on Tiers and Pollen

> 💡 **RMBG keys**: Use the `rmbg_keys` tool (works with any model).

infos.title:
## 🍯💚 POLLINATIONS OPENCODE PLUGIN 💚🍯

Welcome **{name}** to the Pollinations OpenCode plugin!

This plugin empowers you to generate code, images, analyze videos, and interact with top-tier AI models seamlessly within your dev environment. Access state-of-the-art LLMs via chat, refactoring, or terminal.
infos.features_free:
**🛠️ Integrated Free Tools (Always Available) :**
- `gen_qrcode` / `gen_diagram` / `gen_palette` : Visuals and dev utilities.
- `remove_background` : Native background removal.
- `extract_frames` / `extract_audio` : Fast media extraction.
- `file_to_url` : Instant online hosting of local files.
infos.features_pro:
**💎 Pollinations Tools (Premium - Automated with Key) :**
- `polli_gen_image` : Image gen (Flux, Seedream, Gemini) + Image-to-Image.
- `polli_gen_video` : Text-to-video / Image-to-video (Veo, Wan, LTX...).
- `polli_gen_audio`/`polli_stt` : Whisper STT, ElevenLabs TTS.
- `polli_gen_music` : Generative music engine.
- `polli_web_search` : Connected web search.
infos.features_config: - **Granular configuration**, mode and token management, tool cost protections...
infos.about:
## 🌍 What is pollinations.ai ?
pollinations.ai is an open-source AI platform built by and for the community. We provide a unified API for Image, Text, Audio, and Video. Everything is open: our code, roadmap, conversations. Hundreds of devs are already building apps, games, bots, and crazy experiments with us. Join us!

No black boxes. No vendor lock-in. Just a friendly API and a Discord full of helpful people.
infos.levels_list:
For developers creating with pollinations.ai. Level up to earn more daily Pollen.

- 🦠 **Microbe** (0.1 pollen/day) : Sign up
- 🍄 **Spore** (1 pollen/day) : Automatic verification
- 🌱 **Seed** (3 pollen/day) : 8+ dev points
- 🌸 **Flower** (10 pollen/day) : Publish an app
- 🍯 **Nectar** (20 pollen/day) : Coming soon 🔮
infos.beta_note: ✨ *We are in beta! Learning what works best for our community.*
infos.pollen_get:
Running AI models costs money. Pollen is our way to keep servers running without ads or selling data. A simple, unified credit for all models — predictable, transparent, no surprises.

**$1 ≈ 1 Pollen** (prices subject to change). You spend it on API calls.
infos.pollen_spend:
## 🛒 How to get Pollen ?
You can add Pollen by participating in the community, or buying it directly on the dashboard.

image.desc:
Generate an image from a text prompt using Pollinations AI.

💡 **Dynamic Image Models** :
The Pollinations API possesses a large amount of models (Flux, Midjourney, Seedream, etc.) that change frequently. The updated catalog is listed below.

**Optional usage examples** :
- **I2I (Image-to-Image)** : Use the `reference_image` parameter with a URL or local path if the model supports it.
- The tool embeds an automatic "costGuard" managing cost confirmation.

polli_gen_confirm.desc: Validates and executes (or cancels) a Pollinations request previously suspended by Cost Guard. This tool must be called when the user explicitly agrees (or rejects) to spend the estimated amount.
polli_gen_confirm.arg_request_id: The request ID (req_xxxx) returned by the blocked tool.
polli_gen_confirm.arg_action: The action to perform: confirm to start generation, cancel to permanently abort it.
polli_gen_confirm.not_found: ❌ Session not found or expired for ID: {reqId}. Please restart the initial generation.
polli_gen_confirm.cancelled: ✅ Request {reqId} cancelled and removed from queue. Action aborted.

polli_status.desc: Check the current status, available models, live pricing, and account usage/tiers for the Pollinations AI plugin. Use this tool to understand the universe of models, account balance, and usage. NOT for discovering hidden parameters.
polli_status.arg_info_type: Type of information to retrieve: usage=quota/wallet, pricing=model costs, models=list of models, infos=tier details, all=everything

polli_web_search.desc: Universal Pollinations Search module. Retrieve up-to-date web information using web-enabled or specialized LLMs based on their capabilities.
polli_web_search.arg_query: The search query (e.g. "Latest news about AI", "Python 3.12 release notes").
polli_web_search.arg_model: The specific search model to use (see the dynamically injected suggestions for options like perplexity, gemini-search, nomnom, etc.).
polli_web_search.arg_include_sources: Whether to request source URLs in the response. Default: true.
polli_web_search.arg_recency: Time filter (day, week, month) to restrict results to recent information.
polli_web_search.include_sources_prompt: Please include links to your sources at the end of the response.
polli_web_search.recency_day: Limit your research to articles published within the last 24 hours.
polli_web_search.recency_week: Limit your research to articles published within the last 7 days.
polli_web_search.recency_month: Limit your research to articles published within the last 30 days.

Generate a video from a text prompt or image using Pollinations AI.

**Common options examples** :
- `veo` interpolation: Use `reference_image=url1,url2` for transitions.

polli_gen_audio.desc:
Convert text to speech using Pollinations AI.

**🔊 Models:**

| Model | Type | Voices | Format | Cost | Notes |
|-------|------|--------|--------|------|-------|
| openai-audio | TTS + STT | 6 | mp3, wav, pcm16 | Lowest | **DEFAULT** - GPT-4o Audio |
| elevenlabs | TTS | 34 | mp3, wav, etc. | Higher | Expressive voices |

**🎵 OpenAI Audio (Default, Recommended):**
- Voices: `alloy`, `echo`, `fable`, `onyx`, `nova`, `shimmer`
- Formats: `mp3` (default), `wav`, `pcm16`
- Uses GPT-4o Audio Preview modalities endpoint
- Lowest cost option

**🎤 ElevenLabs:**
- 34 expressive voices including: rachel, domi, bella, adam, etc.
- Higher quality natural-sounding speech
- More expensive but more expressive

**💡 Tips:**
- Use `openai-audio` for cost-effective TTS
- Use `elevenlabs` for more expressive/character voices
- For STT (transcription), use the `transcribe_audio` tool.

🔧 Connect your key with /poll connect

💡 OpenAI Voices: {voices}
polli_gen_audio.unsupported_elevenlabs:
⚠️ Voice "{voice}" unrecognized for elevenlabs.
💡 Popular ElevenLabs voices: rachel, domi, bella, adam, josh...
📋 Total: {count} voices available

polli_gen_music.desc:
Generate music from a text description using Pollinations AI.

**🎵 Model:** elevenmusic (ElevenLabs Music)

**📝 Parameters:**
- `duration`: 3-300 seconds (default: 10s)
- `instrumental`: true = no vocals, false = vocals allowed

**💡 Example Prompts:**
- "upbeat jazz with saxophone solo"
- "ambient electronic for meditation"
- "epic orchestral film score"
- "lo-fi hip hop beats"

**💰 Cost:** ~0.005 🌻 per second
- 10 seconds ≈ 0.05 🌻
- 60 seconds ≈ 0.30 🌻

**⚠️ Notes:**
- Generation time scales with duration (~1s per second of audio)
- Longer tracks (60s+) may take 1-2 minutes
- Instrumental mode produces cleaner results for background music
polli_gen_music.arg_prompt: Description of the music to generate
polli_gen_music.req_key:
❌ Music generation requires a Pollinations API key.
🔧 Connect your key with /poll connect
polli_gen_music.err_timeout:
❌ Timeout - Music generation took too long.
💡 Try a shorter duration.

polli_transcribe_audio.desc:
Transcribe audio to text using Pollinations AI.

**🎙️ Models:**

| Model | Supplier | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| whisper-large-v3 | OpenAI | **DEFAULT** - High accuracy, long audio |
| whisper-1 | OpenAI | Standard accuracy |
| scribe | ElevenLabs | Scribe v2 model |

**📁 Supported Formats:**
mp3, wav, m4a, webm, mp4, mpeg, mpga, ogg

**💡 Tips:**
- Use `whisper-large-v3` for the highest accuracy on long recordings
- Supports both local files and URLs

**📋 Output:**
- Returns transcribed text
- Includes detected language (if available)
- Shows processing time

connect_response.onboarding:
## 🌸 Welcome to the Pollinations Plugin

**Immediate free access — no key required**
This plugin provides a complete environment for chat, code generation, and media manipulation (Image, Video, Audio Generation, Extraction Tools...).

Select a `pollinations/free/*` model from the list and start chatting.
{freeText}

---

## 🚀 Multimedia Agents and Tools Integrated for Developers

Claude Opus, GPT-5, Gemini 3, Veo & Wan Video Gen, ElevenLabs Music... unlock the full power of the Pollinations API!

This plugin adopts a **BYOK** (Bring Your Own Key) model: by using your own API key, the OpenCode Agent gains the ability to interact directly with Premium tools, creating your multimedia files in your Workspace.

**Step 1 — Create an account with $10 Free!**
Support the plugin by using this link:
👉 **https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?redirect_url=https://github.com/fkom13/opencode-pollinations-plugin**

**Step 2 — Generate your API key**
In the **API Keys** section on `enter.pollinations.ai`, create a **Secret** key (`sk_...`).

**Step 3 — Connect the key**
```bash
/poll connect sk_your_key_here
```
*(The key is immediately registered in your OpenCode environment, unlocking Pro models!)*

---

## 💰 Pollen System and Tiers
Every developer receives a **Free Daily Grant (Tier Grant)** to use these Premium services:
- 🦠 **Microbe** (0.1 pollen/day) : To unlock: Sign up
- 🍄 **Spore** (1 pollen/day) : To unlock: Automatic verification (Verified upon signup)
- 🌱 **Seed** (3 pollen/day) : To unlock: 8+ dev points (Weekly automatic upgrade)
- 🌸 **Flower** (10 pollen/day) : To unlock: Publish an application
- 🍯 **Nectar** (20 pollen/day) : Coming soon 🔮

Once the free quota is exhausted, you consume Pollen from your wallet ($1 ≈ 1 Pollen, no subscription, no expiration).

**Need help?**
- Type `/poll help` for the list of commands.
- Official Discord: https://discord.gg/pollinations-ai-885844321461485618
